clue.text: The boor seen around remains to do battle

indicators.note: the boor is pictured standing around the remains, so one word wraps the other

parts.note: a lout is a boor, an uncouth man
ash is what remains after burning

explanation.surface: A loutish man hangs about by the ruins, spoiling for a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seen around' puts LOUT round ASH. 'do battle' stands for the phrasal verb meaning to attack wildly.
explanation.definitionFit: To lash out is to strike violently, a close idiom for fighting.

clue.text: Greatest final outside right say reversed

indicators.note: the word for final sits outside the rest

parts.note: last means final

indicators.note: the abbreviation for say is turned round

parts.note: e.g. means say, for example

explanation.surface: A last-minute instruction about the right turn is reversed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversed' turns EG into GE; R + GE goes inside LAST.
explanation.definitionFit: Largest means biggest, the superlative of great in size.

clue.text: Music man putting drink before exercise

indicators.note: the drink comes first, before the exercise

parts.note: to sup is to drink
PE is physical education, exercise at school

explanation.surface: A musician has a drink before working out.
explanation.walkthrough: Franz von Suppé was a 19th-century Austrian composer of operettas.
explanation.definitionFit: Suppé was a composer, best known for the Light Cavalry overture.

clue.text: The antelope's in pain, so rib is obviously broken

indicators.note: the animal is sitting in the run of letters across these words

explanation.surface: An antelope is in pain because a rib is clearly broken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'obviously broken' adds to the surface: the word is broken across 'so rib is'. An oribi is a small African antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: The oribi is a small, fawn-coloured antelope of African grasslands.

clue.text: One's pressed to let off

parts.note: a lever squeezed to fire a gun, read as if someone were pressured to forgive

explanation.definitionFit: A gun's firing lever is squeezed by the finger to discharge the weapon.

clue.text: Aim to go back in a crowd to create distraction

indicators.note: the turned word is placed inside the word for a crowd

parts.note: a mass is a crowd of people

indicators.note: going back means the word for aim is read backwards

parts.note: an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: A heckler in a crowd turns back to cause a disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go back' turns END into DNE, which goes 'in' MASS. Distraction here is the old sense of frenzy or madness, as in 'driven to distraction'.
explanation.definitionFit: Distraction in its older sense is mental derangement, near-insanity.

clue.text: Colour is a factor in some degree

indicators.note: the word for a factor goes inside the degree

parts.note: MA, Master of Arts, is a university degree
an agent or factor acts for another

explanation.surface: Colour is an important element to some extent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts AGENT inside MA. 'factor' looks mathematical but means an agent who acts for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Magenta is a purplish-red dye and hue.

clue.text: Giving particulars of French following

parts.note: de is French for of
tailing someone is following them

explanation.surface: Someone is setting out the facts of a French pursuit.
explanation.definitionFit: Detailing means itemising, setting out every specific point.

clue.text: A person forever on the look-out?

definitions.text: A person forever on the look-out?

parts.words: A person forever on the look-out?
parts.note: not a sentry but someone whose attention always turns outwards to others

explanation.definitionFit: An outgoing personality type whose interest is directed outward, not inward.

clue.text: Prominent foreigner accommodated by a good man

indicators.note: the foreigner is housed inside the good man

parts.note: ST, saint, a good man in crosswords
an alien is a foreigner

explanation.surface: A notable stranger is put up by a kindly fellow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accommodated by' puts ALIEN inside ST.
explanation.definitionFit: Salient means standing out, conspicuous.

clue.text: Going for servicing

definitions.meaning: to repair to a place is to go there, so going

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is 'betaking oneself' (repair to the pub); the other is fixing or overhauling.

clue.text: Setting the small child a money sum

parts.note: a tot is a small child
L, for libra, is the abbreviation for a pound in British money

explanation.surface: Someone sets a little child a money problem to work out.
explanation.definitionFit: A total is the whole amount found by adding, a sum.

clue.text: Getting uniform — in time

definitions.meaning: a time of day, late in the day

explanation.surface: Someone is putting on a uniform just in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Evening out a surface is making it level; evening is also the part of the day after afternoon.

clue.text: No-one taking part is offensive

indicators.note: the first piece takes the second after it, joining them in order

parts.note: NO from the word no, plus I, the Roman numeral for one
some means a part or portion of something

explanation.surface: Not one person joining in is unpleasant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No-one' splits into NO and I (one as a Roman numeral).
explanation.definitionFit: Noisome means foul-smelling or objectionable, so offensive.

clue.text: A tart trio employed in a restaurant

indicators.note: the letters are put to use in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Three loose women have found jobs in an Italian eatery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'employed' rearranges the nine letters of A TART TRIO.
explanation.definitionFit: A trattoria is a simple Italian eating house.

clue.text: Vivacity may turn into mania

indicators.note: the letters are allowed to turn into a new order

explanation.surface: High spirits can tip over into frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may turn' rearranges INTO MANIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Animation means liveliness and spirit, vivacity.

clue.text: Goes with roofing material as a way to gain access

parts.note: turns, as in goes or takes a turn
a tile covers a roof

explanation.surface: Roof tiles are used to get in somewhere.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolving gate admits people one at a time, at a stadium or station.

clue.text: To shut up about entering it is pointless

indicators.note: the turned word goes into the word it
about means the word for shut up is turned round

parts.note: to pen an animal is to shut it up

explanation.surface: Telling someone to keep quiet about it achieves nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns PEN into NEP, and 'entering' puts it inside IT.
explanation.definitionFit: Inept means lacking skill or sense, so ineffectual and pointless.

clue.text: A continental city magistrate

definitions.meaning: An old city in western Germany
one who tries cases, a judge

explanation.surface: A European official from a city on the Moselle.
explanation.definitionFit: Trier is a German city on the Moselle; a trier is also one who tries cases, a judge.

clue.text: Capital investment, which is absorbing work

indicators.note: the phrase for which is takes in the word for work

parts.note: that's, short for that is, means which is
op, opus, is a work

explanation.surface: Capital investment, it seems, is a demanding job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital investment' is something put on the head (capital), i.e. a tall formal hat. 'absorbing' puts OP inside THATS.
explanation.definitionFit: Tall formal headwear is literally invested (clothed) upon the head, the capital.

clue.text: There's a lot a girl can change in a fearsome beast

indicators.note: the letters are free to change places into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl can change a lot inside a frightening monster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can change' rearranges A LOT A GIRL.
explanation.definitionFit: An alligator is a large toothed reptile, a fearsome animal.

clue.text: These days get into line for a lecture

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, the present era
to dress ranks is the military order to line up

explanation.surface: Nowadays people queue up for a talk.
explanation.walkthrough: Dress is the drill command for soldiers to straighten their line.
explanation.definitionFit: An address is a formal speech, as a lecture is.

clue.text: Food left — a dip and nauseating starters

parts.note: a sag is a dip or droop

indicators.note: starters asks for the first letters of the neighbouring words

explanation.surface: A leftover dip and some sickening starters make a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'starters' must be taken as N then A, nauseating before 'and', a loose order on the setter's part.
explanation.definitionFit: Lasagna is an Italian baked pasta dish.

clue.text: Bars a game controller avails himself of

parts.note: a ref, referee, controls a game
uses, makes use of

explanation.surface: A referee takes advantage of bars.
explanation.definitionFit: Refuses means turns down or rejects, as bars does.

clue.text: Produced after midshipmen cracked up

indicators.note: the word for produced comes after the picked letter
mid asks for the middle letter of the word it is joined to

parts.note: raised, as in bred or brought up

explanation.surface: Naval cadets were laughing hysterically after something was brought out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'midshipmen' splits as 'mid' + SHIPMEN: the middle letter of SHIPMEN is P. 'cracked up' is the definition in the sense of highly praised.
explanation.definitionFit: To be cracked up is to be extolled or talked up, which is being lauded.

clue.text: Oriental coppers a superior guy dismissed

parts.note: the sen is a small coin of Japan and other Asian countries
a toff is a posh, upper-class man

explanation.surface: Eastern police officers ejected a snooty gentleman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police but means small coins. A TOFF is British slang for an upper-class man.
explanation.definitionFit: Sent off is the phrase for being ordered away, as a footballer is.

clue.text: Bottle never properly treated

indicators.note: the letters, given treatment, settle into a new order

explanation.surface: A bottle has never been handled correctly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'properly treated' rearranges NEVER. Bottle is British slang for courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Bottle in British slang is courage, the same as having guts.

clue.text: None over ten view this as a bloomer

indicators.note: in a down answer, the nil sits over the rest

parts.note: O is zero, none
X is the Roman numeral for ten
to eye is to view

explanation.surface: Nobody over ten would see this as a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' looks like a blunder but means a flower: the oxeye daisy.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxeye is a daisy, a plant that blooms.

clue.text: The defence put in a different situation

definitions.text: The defence put in a different situation

parts.words: The defence put in a different situation
parts.note: the plea in court that the accused was somewhere else at the time

explanation.definitionFit: The Latin word means elsewhere, and the plea claims presence in another place.

clue.text: The eccentric sees anger as ardour

indicators.note: the letters behave oddly and fall into a new order

explanation.surface: An odd character perceives fury as passion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eccentric' rearranges SEES ANGER.
explanation.definitionFit: Eagerness is keen enthusiasm, the same warmth as ardour.

clue.text: People burning to be entertainers

definitions.meaning: those who singe or scorch things
performers who sing for an audience

explanation.definitionFit: Read as singe-ers they scorch things; read normally they are vocalists, performers.

clue.text: Staying youthful, since without set ways

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so one word wraps the others

parts.note: as can mean since, because
to gel is to set, as a jelly does
E and S are two compass directions, so two ways

explanation.surface: Someone stays young-looking because they never settled into habits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here: AS goes round GEL + ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageless describes someone who never seems to grow older.
